**A [[United Nations Interim Force in Lebanon|UNIFIL patrol unit]] is hit by IDF gunfire in the vicinity of [[Aitaroun]] with no casualties. UNIFIL condemned the incident and called on parties to be reminded "of their obligations to protect peacekeepers and avoid putting the men and women who are working to restore stability at risk."[https://english.alarabiya.net/News/middle-east/2023/11/25/UNIFIL-says-Israeli-gunfire-hit-one-of-its-patrols-in-southern-Lebanon (AlArabiya)] 
*[[Russian invasion of Ukraine]]
**[[Russia]] launches 75 [[unmanned combat aerial vehicle|drones]] against Ukraine from two directions, [[Primorsko-Akhtarsk]] and the [[Kursk]] region. In response, [[Ukraine]] launches 20 drones against Russia, including the capital, [[Moscow]]. [https://edition.cnn.com/2023/11/26/europe/russia-destroys-ukrainian-drones-moscow-intl/index.html (CNN)] [https://www.reuters.com/world/europe/mass-drone-attack-kyiv-mayor-says-two-injured-2023-11-25/ (Reuters)] [https://apnews.com/article/russia-ukraine-war-shahed-drones-kyiv-attack-ad3eef50f980a4df023fad78d7bc197d (AP)]
